LESSON: HIJRA TO MADINA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: History of Islam
Topic 7.3: Hijra to Madina

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Hijra to Madina. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Hijra to Madina
2. Practise Hijra to Madina at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hijra to Madina

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Hijra to Madina
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Hijra to Madina. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Hijra to Madina at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Hijra to Madina at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hijra to Madina
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Hijra to Madina. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Hijra to Madina using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Hijra to Madina in the examples.
2. Explain Hijra to Madina to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Hijra to Madina.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hijra to Madina using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Hijra to Madina important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Hijra to Madina
2. Practise Hijra to Madina at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Hijra to Madina

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
